soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 (full rigidity atlas)
soundness_flags.one_line: For unrestricted real observed probabilities, a rigid rational formula need not evaluate to a real algebraic number; restrict the exact algebraic-output claim to rational input or specify algebraicity over the input coefficient field.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 6 (separated Wald)

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 7 (confidence-fiber coverage)

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 6 (separated Wald)
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Wald inference is conditional on a compact separated rigid chart and nonsingular target covariance.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Regular Wald inference only on separated nonsingular charts; transition laws are not covered by this claim.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 7 (confidence-fiber coverage)
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Fiber inversion asserts coverage but no root-n diameter at genuinely unidentified collision laws.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Honest coverage through transitions, without a shrinking-diameter claim at nonidentification.
